verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for any public web service, including a state filing agency, so the axis applies. Direct probes found nothing: llms.txt returns 404, the markdown docs variant returns 404, and no llms.txt was found on any of the agency's hosts. The first-party docs are human-oriented HTML pages only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
